messages:
maria: Quick PSA  pausing tomorrow's multi-region cutover. Detected quota-router header edge-case that could misroute Dedicated tenants.
jon: Copy. Pause only, no rollback planned?
maria: Correct. We're patching a defensive shim and will validate in canary.
leo: PR incoming for shim normalization. Will deploy to infra-canary-1 in ~20m.
sre-bot: deploy-start maria/shim -> infra-canary-1
ops: What alert thresholds should we use during validation?
maria: Set latency +20% sustained 10m and error-rate >0.5% for 5m to trigger rollback.
leo: Canary logs after deploy: health=ok, routing-checks 995/1000 pass. Failures look like header-ordering only.
jon: If canary >=99% over 30m, plan staged ramp: 10% -> 40% -> 100% with 1h soaks. Ben will own ramps? (Ben OOO today)
maria: Jon will own ramps today. Leo owns validations, Ops owns monitoring/rollback, I'll handle comms.
ops: Posting CS update: "Cutover paused; patching and validating. ETA decision 2-4h."
jon: Kicking 10% ramp now. infra-cmd: ramp --service quota-router --pct 10 --from canary-1
sre-bot: ramp-event id=rmp-363 pct=10 service=quota-router status=started
jon: 10m snapshot: latency +2%, errors 0.05%. No alerts.
leo: Added regression test for header-order to preflight. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/quota-router/pull/810
maria: Good work. If 1h soak stays green, proceed to 40%. Will post final decision here. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
